title: The 7 Worst Businesses to Buy or Start (The Blacklist)
rules: 1. Restaurants & Bars: 80% failure rate, sub-5% net margins, high employee turnover, fragile perishable inventory.
2. Fads & Trend Hype (e.g. Frozen yogurt, escape rooms, axe throwing): Revenue collapses after novelty fades; zero sustainable moat.
3. Commodity Dropshipping / Low-barrier E-commerce: Squeezed by ad platforms (Meta/Google) and overseas factories copying designs in 48 hours.
4. Environmental Liability Businesses (Dry cleaners with PERC chemicals, old uncertified gas stations): Potential $500k+ EPA remediation liabilities.
5. Pure Agency / Solo Consulting: Key-man risk where the talent IS the product; revenue leaves the building when the owner leaves.
6. Heavy-CapEx Machinery with Low Margin: Buying businesses where equipment replacement cost exceeds 2 years of net profit.
7. Single-Platform Dependency: Businesses that rely entirely on one algorithm (Amazon FBA, Etsy, TikTok shop) with no customer email list.
